changes.title: Convert legacy FIDO2 settings to an explicit Default passkey profile
changes.rationale: Makes the synced-passkey decision explicit instead of inherited from the old attestation toggle.

changes.title: Retarget profile(s) 'Default' from 'Passkey Pilot' to a group without admins
changes.rationale: Entra allows a passkey if any scoped profile allows it, so a loose profile on a target that contains admins overrides their strict profile.
notes: The proposed group is a static snapshot. In production, keep it current with a dynamic membership rule or by excluding your role-assignable admin groups from it.

changes.title: Create profile 'Admins - device-bound, attested'
changes.rationale: Admins need a profile that only accepts device-bound, attested passkeys.
notes: Add an AAGUID allow list for your approved security keys.

changes.title: Scope privileged users to 'Admins - device-bound, attested'
changes.rationale: Every admin should be scoped to the strict profile, and only to it.
notes: Prefer targeting your existing role-assignable admin group instead of this snapshot group.

changes.title: Scope 4 SMS/voice-only user(s) to profile 'Default'
changes.rationale: They will get a blocking passkey prompt when SMS/voice retires, but policy does not let them register one.

after.target: SMS/voice users without a passkey path

notes: Or widen the existing workforce target so it includes them.

changes.title: Point the registration campaign at passkeys for all users, with limited snoozes
changes.rationale: 5 SMS/voice-only user(s) need a nudge before their deadline.
notes: Check the targetedAuthenticationMethod value your tenant's Graph version accepts.
